sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Hide scrollbar option
Brings back the setting to hide the scroll bar.
Hide update badge
Removes the update red dot from the menu and Settings.
Remove address bar blur
Solid address and bottom bars instead of the blurred gradient.
Remove tab limit
Removes the 99-tab limit.
Remove telemetry
Stops Samsung's usage logs, analytics and crash reports, and keeps the app offline until its terms are accepted.
Theme color on bottom bar
The page's theme color also colors the bottom address bar and bottom bar.

sources.label: Supercharged Samsung Internet (Morphe patches) — Chrome Web Store extensions on
sources.author: SBrowserX
patch_list: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency
Adds adjustable toolbar and bottom bar transparency with frosted-glass blur and pure AMOLED black mode for the browser interface.
Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
Adds an 'After 1 day' option to the Auto-close unused tabs setting.
Block third-party cookies by default
Blocks third-party cookies by default across all websites, with an option to re-enable them in Settings.
Built-in Google Translate engine
Adds a built-in page translation engine with automatic translation and quick language settings.
Change package and app name
Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, and app display name so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside stock Samsung Internet.
Disable Update Prompts & Badges
Hides store update prompts, banners, and update badges.
External downloader support
Sends file, image, video, and link downloads to your chosen external download manager.
Remove 99-Tab Limit
Removes the 99-tab limit so you can keep thousands of open tabs.
Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
Removes built-in analytics, promotional banners, shopping ads, and background update checks while keeping website notifications working.
SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.
Third-Party Autofill Support
Enables native Android Autofill (Bitwarden, Gboard inline suggestions), removes Samsung Pass prompts, and unlocks local credit cards without Knox.
Unified Dark Mode & True AMOLED Websites
Synchronizes website dark mode with the browser theme, removes dim overlays, and applies pure AMOLED black backgrounds when enabled.
Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
Enables extension support, unlocks the Chrome Web Store, and allows installing and keeping third-party extensions.
Unlock Compact Layout
Unlocks the compact floating toolbar layout, smooths scrolling behavior, and lets you customize the extra toolbar button.
Unlock Debug settings menu
Reveals the hidden Debug settings menu inside browser Settings.
